{{Top}}
{{Youmay|the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] position of Fleet Admiral|[[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] rank that superseded [[Admiral of the Fleet/Legends|Admiral of the Fleet]]}}
{{Quote|Fleet Admirals have it made. They only have to worry about the success of their subordinates, their Moff and guys whose name begins with Lord.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Seledrood]]|<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
The rank of '''Fleet Admiral''' was a naval rank used in several eras.

==History==
[[File:Fleet_Admiral_Aygo.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Republic Fleet Admiral [[Bey'wan Aygo]].]]
The rank was first used in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The Fleet Admirals were possibly part of the [[Admiralty (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Admiralty]].

Within the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], Fleet Admiral was not a formal line rank but a position that could be held by [[Admiral/Legends|Admirals]] or [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admirals]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> The title of Fleet Admiral was accorded to the commanding officer of a major fleet within a [[Sector Group/Legends|Sector Group]]. A Fleet Admiral answered directly to the [[High Admiral]] in charge of Navy operations within their Sector, who was normally the [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the sector. His own command might be a front-line [[Superiority fleet]], an [[Assault fleet]] or [[Bombard fleet]] for planetary suppression operations, or a logistical [[Deepdock fleet]] or [[Support fleet]]. A Fleet Admiral was a very important member of the military hierarchy within a [[Sector/Legends|Sector]], with authority over multiple [[systems force]]s commanded by subordinate [[systems admiral]]s.

The commanding officer of [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] under [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was also a Fleet Admiral, such as [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]] and [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]].

In the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Sien Sovv]] held the rank of Fleet Admiral during his leadership of the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|Defense Force]].

==Behind the scenes==
The rank of Fleet Admiral is introduced in the ''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]'' for [[West End Games]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'', but it is not clear whether it is to be understood as a formal rank, or a title denoting a certain sort of command: the other posts discussed in the same section include some that seem to be substantive ranks, most obviously [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Captain of the Line]], but also others that are evidently positional titles, such as a ship's captain and an Admiral's adjutant. The example of Michael Unther, who was apparently a Fleet Admiral before achieving the substantive rank of [[Rear Admiral/Legends|Rear Admiral]], adds weight to the hypothesis that "Fleet Admiral" was a title rather than a real rank; indeed, Unther's subsequent promotion to flag rank suggets that some Fleet Admirals were actually [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Line Captains]] or [[Commander/Legends|Commanders]] by rank.

A number of fan websites have speculated as to the rank insignia of Fleet Admirals, among which probably the most influential discussion is that at the [[Curtis Saxton|Star Wars Technical Commentaries]] website (see [http://theforce.net/swtc/insignia/badges.html#fleetadmiral here]). More cautiously, it can be noted that the rank insignia worn by Admirals [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Ozzel]] and [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Piett]] as commanders of Death Squadron in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']] are probably appropriate for a Fleet Admiral, with both men sharing the same insignia - six red squares over six blue, with two code cylinders on the left and one on the right; however, it is impossible to say whether this insignia was in any way specifically appropriate for a Fleet Admiral, or if it indicated some other substantive rank which both men held while commanding Death Squadron.
